intro: IM-2 was Intuitive Machines' second Moon mission. Its Nova-C lander Athena touched down on 6 March 2025 on Mons Mouton, about 160 km from the south pole. Its laser altimeter was noisy all the way down; Athena hit faster than intended and came to rest on its side in a crater 20 m across, its solar panels turned away from the Sun. It worked for under 13 hours.

images.caption: Athena seen obliquely by the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter, at 84.7906 S, 29.1957 E.
A closer view of Athena in its crater from the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter.
